title: Sealed Vintage Coca-Cola Keepsake Tin & Coca-Cola Set - New
descriptionText: The product is a sealed vintage Coca-Cola brand keepsake tin featuring the iconic red, brown, and silver colors. It is an original item with a soda theme, perfect for collectors of Coca-Cola memorabilia. The tin may also include a Coca-Cola brand item, with both items maintaining their original forms without any modifications.
